name: Default mail, navigation, dialer and messaging apps
plain: Changes which app opens email, maps, calls, texts and passwords.
meaning: Android has had roles for dialer and SMS for years. iOS added default mail and browser in 14, then maps, messaging, calling, passwords and translation in later releases.

android.store_policy: Play: SMS and Call Log policy
android.note: Dialer and SMS roles have extra Play policy review.

ios.permission: Default app entitlements (managed); Mail, Maps, Messaging, Phone role support
ios.store_policy: Navigation, call and messaging defaults are available in the EU (iOS 18.2+) and Japan
ios.api_surface: Default navigation (EU iOS 17.4 era), Default apps UI in iOS 18.2
ios.note: Scope varies by app type and region.

limits.headline: Can open your email, maps, calls and texts, once you set it as the default
limits.user_action: You accept a role request dialog, or pick a default in Settings
can: Open email links, map links, calls or texts after you set it as default
Ask you through a role request on Android 10 or newer
Be set in Default Apps on iPhone for supported types
cannot: Become the default without your approval
Take over dialer or messages on Android without Google Play review
Cover every type on iPhone; it depends on app type and region
limits.reach_label: Every link of that kind, if chosen
limits.differs: Android uses role requests. iPhone lets you set defaults only for some app types, and by region.

story.what_it_is: Chooses which app handles email, maps, calls, texts and passwords.

marketing.name: Change default apps
marketing.pitch: Apple lets people choose default apps for mail, browsing and more in Settings.

story.for_you: You choose which mail, maps or phone app opens when you tap an address or number. The system then uses your choice everywhere.
story.for_makers: Makers want to be the default because it brings steady use. Platforms add new default types over time as rules change.

use_cases.example: You pick Google Maps for every address link.
You pick Gmail as the app that opens email links.
You choose a texting app other than the built in one.
A fake dialer asks to be default to see your calls, so stores review it.
A tap to pay link opens your chosen wallet.
Your car navigation opens in your chosen maps app.
A work mail app is set as default on company phones.

story.android_note: Android has roles for dialer and texts with extra Play review.
story.ios_note: Scope varies by app type and region. Settings show Default Apps.

technical_bounds: Region and category specific on iOS

history.change: Default Apps settings with regional extras
